abstract: Completing Task 15 and its parent, Task 3, to mark the successful development and integration of the Experimentation Framework. The script then runs view_tasks.py for verification.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import sys

UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"

# --- Mark tasks as completed ---
print("--- Completing Tactical Layer Tasks ---")
# Mark sub-task 15 as completed
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "15", "completed"], check=True)
# Mark parent task 3 as completed
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "3", "completed"], check=True)
print("Tasks 15 and 3 have been marked as COMPLETED.")

# --- Verification ---
print("\\n--- Running verification ---")
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import view_tasks
from telos import task_manager
all_tasks = task_manager.load_tasks()
view_tasks.display_tasks(all_tasks)
print("--- Verification complete. ---")
